card.name: Words just before a therapy or program noun
card.fires_on: Modifier or linking words (best, available, the, a, lipid, restricted) that come right before a noun like therapy, arm, or program in drug-label trial and warning text. It also fires on a space before a number of months.

modes.label: Comparator wording
modes.description: Words in phrases like 'best available therapy' or 'the vancomycin-treated arm' that compare treatment groups.
modes.example: as compared to best<< available>> therapy (BAT) in a multinational,

modes.label: Modifier before therapy or program
modes.description: An adjective before a therapy or program noun.
modes.example: FINTEPLA is available only through a<< restricted>> program under a REMS

modes.label: Space before duration
modes.description: A space before a number of months after stopping a drug.
modes.example: avoid anthracycline-based therapy for up to<< >>7 months after stopping trastuzum

card.writes: It lowers the chance that the next word is 'group' or 'groups', which fits a noun like therapy or arm coming next.
card.plain: It marks a word that sits right before a noun like therapy or arm in a trial comparison or warning, where the next word is not 'group'.
